name: Dephaser JPY
oneLiner: JPYT is DePhaser's yen stablecoin, minted by locking USDT on Optimism or USDC on Base against a yen FX oracle, with collateral returned on redemption.
collateral: USDT locked on Optimism and USDC locked on Base through the DePhaser platform to mint JPYT
pegMechanism: Users lock USDT on Optimism or USDC on Base to mint JPYT against a real-time yen exchange-rate oracle; the redemption flow permits/burns JPYT and returns the selected USDT or USDC collateral to the user

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Freeze-only re-review: JPYT has no direct holder freeze or blacklist function in the reviewed source; burnFrom remains allowance-gated even when called by BURNER_ROLE. JPYT resolves to Upstream through locked USDT/USDC reserve exposure.

mintAuthority.summary: JPYT has Pharos token-source evidence for privileged mint/admin authority; Mint Authority records it as a permissioned minter path pending threshold and cap review.

controls.label: Privileged token mint/admin authority
controls.evidence: JPYT has Pharos token-source evidence for privileged mint or mint-admin authority; Mint Authority records that authority pending deeper threshold/cap verification.

review.evidence: JPYT has Pharos token-source evidence for privileged mint or mint-admin authority; Mint Authority records that authority pending deeper threshold/cap verification.

reserves.name: Locked USDT on Optimism and USDC on Base
